answer: Require each agent to post a bond that is locked before it can submit claims, then slash that bond when independent audits prove the claims false. A sybil attacker can still forge many identities, but each one must tie up real capital, and detected fraud destroys part of it; creating a nebula of disposable accounts therefore becomes costly rather than free. The fable of a thousand agents is no longer persuasive unless the attacker can fund them all.
